card.name: Word-initial St at start of terms
card.fires_on: The piece "St" (or "ST", "st") that begins a new word, often right after a period, list item or "with". Seen in St. John's wort, Stomatitis, stenosing, Stages, Stagger and STIOLTO.

modes.label: St. John's wort
modes.description: "St" opening the herb name St. John's wort in interaction headings and lists.
modes.example: 5.10 Interaction with<< St>>. John’s Wort or Rifampin

modes.label: St- medical terms
modes.description: "St" starting a medical word such as stomatitis, stenosing or stages, often at the start of a sentence or list item.
modes.example: micrograms per day.<< St>>omatitis (mouth sores), alo

modes.label: Brand or other St- words
modes.description: "ST" or "st" starting a brand name or a plant-habitat word.
modes.example: Do not initiate<< ST>>IOLTO RESPIMAT in ac

card.writes: It suppresses continuations beginning with "ex", so it does little to help the model predict the rest of the word.
card.plain: It fires on the letters "St" when they start a new word, like St. John's wort or stomatitis.
